Message:
I got back to training and
took hold of my sword.

Its light was only a glimmer,
and nothing like it once was.
But—

When I lost everything,
and was left completely alone,
I realized an undeniable truth.

I have nothing.
The justice I believed in,
my precious mission...

They were all given to me
by someone else.
I had nothing of my own...

That’s why the holy sword
lost its light.
It only made sense
that it would...
But—

“So once we find everyone again,
we should totally go on
another journey together!”

“B-Because,
I want to help...my friend...!”

“You’re so dependable,
always working so hard like that.”

Even after
losing everything,
everyone still
stayed by my side.

It turns out...
I hadn’t really
lost anything at all...

The holy sword’s light
is still shining.

It’s a faint, but warm light...
As warm as
everyone’s smiles...

...Ahh...
It’s been here staring me
right in the face all along.

It was just so small,
I refused to see it.

Even though that tiny glimmer
is the very one cast by my bonds
woven with everyone—my light...

As if celebrating me
finally opening my eyes,
the holy sword’s light
grew stronger.

It wasn’t the white,
cold light of justice
that shone before.

The warm light of the sun,
granted to me by our bonds,
bathed the holy sword
in its golden radiance.

...! ...Thank you, everyone.
I won’t waver anymore...!

Because now I know
I have such a gentle light...

The light of my bonds
with everyone, at my side...!
